label: OpenAI
description: OpenAI API key + Codex coding agent for Settings → LLMs. Install from Store → Gateways, then enable to show OpenAI under Providers & Keys and Codex under Coding Agents.

settings.sections.title: OpenAI prompt caching
settings.sections.description: Bill-discount prefix caching markers on API calls. Separate from Ducky's freeze prefix (works for all providers).

properties.label: Enable OpenAI cache markers
properties.description: Splits the stable system prefix so OpenAI can reuse cached input tokens across turns.

steps.title: Open OpenAI
steps.body: Press the OpenAI row in this table. The page slides open so you can paste a key or use Codex.

steps.title: API key or Codex
steps.body: Paste an OpenAI API key here to use GPT in Ducky chats. No key? Skip this and use Codex on this same slide — ChatGPT login is enough.

steps.title: Test & Save
steps.body: Press Test & Save after you paste a key. Using Codex without a key? Press Skip.

steps.title: Codex
steps.body: Codex is OpenAI's coding agent. Detect finds the CLI. Keep it on to pick Codex in chat.
